newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cocoa futures called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cocoa futures called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE cocoa futures were called to open little changed on Thursday, on the heels of an uneventful performance in London overnight, traders said.

London cocoa futures were narrowly mixed in light trade early Thursday. At the midday break, LIFFE September was up one stg, to 1,027 stg, after trading in a tight 1,029-1,026 stg range. December was one stg firmer, at 1,056 stg.

New York cocoa ended higher in light, rangebound dealings on Wednesday, with active December rising $12 a tonne, to $1,527, after ranging from $1,532 to $1,520. Spot September ended $7 firmer, at $1,499, while the back months gained $13 to $18.
September/December ended at $28 compared with $23 at the close on Monday.
On the charts, traders said December continued to face resistance at $1,535, with the next level seen at $1,543-$1,545. On the downside, support was seen near $1,520.
